observations: Black DSLR body with 'Canon' logo and 'EOS 760D' text visible on photo 0 and photo 1.
Body shown without a lens cap; rear mount visible with no lens attached in photos 0 and 1; a separate lens barrel is visible in the background of all three photos but its model text is not readable.
Built-in pop-up flash is raised in photos 0, 1, and 2.
A separate small black unit resembling an external flash/speedlite sits beside the camera in photo 2, logo/model not legible.
No camera bag visible in any photo.
No microphone visible in any photo.
No battery, charger, memory card, or strap box shown.
Watermarks 'POSTED ON JIJI' and 'CLINTON OTOGIE' overlay all three photos; no functional test (power-on, screen, shutter) is shown.

claims.claim: It is a great and affordable camera for the price
claims.evidence: Subjective opinion, no photo can confirm or deny performance or value.
No bag appears in photo 0, 1, or 2.
No microphone appears in any of the three photos.
Built-in pop-up flash visible in photos 0, 1, 2; a separate possible external flash unit also visible in photo 2.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or shutter may not fire (no functional test shown).
risks.proof: A clip or photo of the camera powered on with the rear LCD showing a live image, plus an audible/visible shutter fire.

risks.risk: Shutter count unknown, which affects DSLR resale value heavily.
risks.proof: A photo of the shutter count from a menu screen or EOSInfo-type app reading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high/unknown shutter count (worst case)

risks.risk: Lens model, mount compatibility, and glass/zoom condition unknown (no readable text, no close-up of glass).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the lens barrel text (model/focal length) and a shot through the glass for fungus/scratches.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a low-value generic kit lens, condition unverified

risks.risk: Claimed bag and microphone are not shown, so inclusion cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the bag and microphone laid out next to the camera.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + lens + flash only, bag and mic excluded

risks.risk: No battery, charger, or memory card shown; these are needed for actual use.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery, charger, and card included in the sale.

risks.risk: External flash unit's brand/model and working condition cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the flash unit's branding/model and a test photo showing it firing.

risks.risk: General cosmetic/internal condition (LCD scratches, sensor dust/fungus, body wear) not fully visible.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the LCD screen, sensor (with lens off, mirror up), and body corners/edges.
risks.if_unproven: priced as heavy visible wear, worst case

proof_requests: Video of the camera powering on, showing a live preview, and firing the shutter.
Close-up photo of the shutter count from the camera's menu or a shutter-count app.
Clear photo of the lens barrel showing brand, model, and focal length/aperture range.
Photo of the bag and microphone laid out together with the camera.
Photo of the battery, charger, and memory card included.
Close-up of the external flash's branding/model and a test shot of it firing.
response.reason: The Canon EOS 760D body is clearly identified by text in photo 0 and photo 1, and a built-in flash is visibly present, so a worst-case price can be set; however, unverified accessories (bag, microphone, lens model, battery/charger) and an unproven functional state mean it must be priced conservatively until proof is supplied.
